concept.name: Alliances

concept.name: Claim and evidence
concept.summary: A strong answer states a clear claim and supports it with accurate quotations from the text.

excerpts.text: She stood in the kitchen doorway and counted the boxes twice, as if the number might change. Her father had said the mainland school was a gift, and she had nodded as he spoke.

The sea had always told her when to wake, and tonight it was loud. She ran her thumb along the worn railing one last time, then pulled her hand back and pushed it into her pocket, as though the rail might remember her.

otherConcepts.name: Quoting versus paraphrasing
otherConcepts.summary: A quotation uses the author's exact words; a paraphrase restates the idea in your own words.

concept.name: Quoting versus paraphrasing
concept.summary: A quotation uses the author's exact words in quotation marks; a paraphrase restates the idea in your own words.
